notes: Jarvis improves himself: weekly (or 'improve yourself') he writes rules from your corrections, losing autopilot trades and errors, tests them blind against his old self, and shows them to approve. The mirror: 'study how I decide', then 'what does my mirror say about ...' plays a decision forward from your own record. Experiments: 'test whether I trade better after 7 hours of sleep' gathers daily numbers and reports. A team of agents: 'get the team to ship my demo' runs a planner, coder and critic on a copy with checkpoints. Time capsule: your dated predictions, plans and promises are read back on their day.
